A request for purpleheart should identify the product form as well as the species. The written quote should specify the actual material, measured dimensions, condition, quantity and delivery terms so the offered lot can be compared with your project requirements.

faqs.question: How do I request a price for purpleheart lumber?
faqs.answer: Include the dimensions, quantity in board feet, intended use and destination ZIP. Those details allow material and delivery costs to be quoted for the same requirement.

faqs.question: Can I review the actual material before ordering?
